axes_source: Read from data/brands/openai.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #000000 and the canvas #FFFFFF; contrast from the ink #0D0D0D on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #000000; density from its 8px spacing base; geometry from its radii 4, 8, 12, 24px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion from its stated durations 200ms, 400ms; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #000000 reaches 21.00:1 on the canvas #FFFFFF, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
name: OpenAI
